One versioned JSON report includes the event log, Debug Console, AudioTrack evidence, route-policy events, output classifier, and race capture. Reports are bounded and remain local until you copy or save them.

The player must be created after recording starts to observe its actual AudioTrack route. Please pause playback first. Restarting BookWave closes the current playback process and opens the app again. The opt-in recorders start automatically in the new process. Unsaved playback may be interrupted.
